nodes.text: HSBC HK App 升級 ‧ 就你⬆️｜「線上對話」篇📱

【升級？就係簡單講幾句就明你想點 🙌🏻】 唔見咗銀包想報失卡點算好😨？突然想問一啲有關銀行嘅事？...收到你👌！而家只要打開HSBC HK App，將你嘅問題直接講出嚟就幫到你！ 升級嘅「線上對話」新增咗語音識別功能🗣，可以直接將語音轉成文字，再解答你嘅問題。仲會一步一步咁指導你完成操作👆🏻，簡單又方便。無論係想block卡定check電子結單等等嘅問題，隨時隨地，你問我答👌！ HSBC HK App📱仲有好多升級咗嘅新功能，快啲了解更多啦！https://grp.hsbc/NSCWUYT 屏幕顯示僅供參考及說明用途。 #滙豐 #流動理財應用程式 #線上對話 【What’s better than…getting support by saying just a few words 🙌🏻】 Whether you’ve lost your wallet or need banking assistance? We’ve got you 👌🏻! Just open the refreshed HSBC HK App and ask away. With the upgraded voice recognition, you can now directly convert your voice into text🗣. From blocking cards to reading statements, ‘Chat with us’ will guide you step-by-step, and provide the answers you need, anytime, anywhere 👌! How else have we made the HSBC HK App better 📱? Learn more: https://grp.hsbc/NSCWUYT The screen displays are for reference and illustration purposes only. #HSBC #HSBCHKApp #ChatWithUs
